observations: Photo 0: A children's bicycle with blue handlebars, blue rims, black frame with red and black Spider-Man graphics, training wheels, and a black seat with blue and white accents. The bike is positioned on a tiled pavement next to a bush.
Photo 1: Same bicycle from a different angle, showing the front wheel, handlebars, and the Spider-Man logo on the frame. Training wheels are visible. The bike is on a concrete ledge next to a bush.
The frame has a visible 'SPIDER-MAN' logo in yellow text on a red background, confirming the character theme.
The bike has two training wheels, one on each side of the rear wheel.
The front wheel has a blue rim and black tire; the rear wheel also has a blue rim and black tire.
The handlebars have black grips and a brownish textured grip in the center.
No visible brand name or model number on the frame or components.
The double brake system is not clearly visible; only the front brake lever is visible on the right handlebar. The rear brake is not shown.

claims.claim: The amazing spiderman character children bicycle
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the Spider-Man logo and graphics on the frame.
Only the front brake lever is visible; the rear brake mechanism is not shown. No photo shows both brakes.

risks.risk: The training wheels may be loose, damaged, or not securely attached
risks.proof: A close-up photo of both training wheels showing their attachment points and condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unsafe or needing repair

risks.risk: The frame or components may have hidden damage or rust not visible in photos
risks.proof: A photo showing the underside of the frame, chain, and joints, especially near the seat post and bottom bracket.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly having structural issues

proof_requests: Close-up photo of both front and rear brake levers and mechanisms to verify the double brake system.
Close-up photo of the training wheels showing their attachment and condition.
Photo of the underside of the frame and chain area to check for damage or rust.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a children's Spider-Man bicycle, but the claim of a double brake system is unverified, and there are hidden risks related to brakes, training wheels, and frame condition. These must be proven before pricing can be determined accurately.
